name: signature-map
description: Signature Map indexes and queries code declarations in signatures.json for low-token navigation across Swift, Objective-C, C/C++, Kotlin, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby, and shell.

interface.longDescription: Signature Map indexes repository declarations in signatures.json, queries exact names or regex, opens bounded source, and diagnoses index health across Swift, Objective-C, C/C++, Kotlin, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby, and shell.
capabilities: Incremental repo-wide declaration indexing into signatures.json
Exact-name and regex declaration search with kind, subtree, and limit filters
Bounded-context source opening around declarations and file:line locations
Batch snippet extraction from selector lists
defaultPrompt: Use Signature Map to find where this symbol is declared in the repo.
Use Signature Map to survey this module's API surface before editing it.
Use Signature Map to open the code around these declarations with context.
